listing.name: Call of Duty: Finest Hour (Finest Hour Remastered)
listing.summary: Windows Finest Hour Remastered guidance for an independently permitted, already completed CODFH.exe installation using your exact PAL Xbox copy. Upstream owns setup and updates; continuation across quick-reboot, updater or restart successors is outside this entry’s scope.

steps.title: Use an independently permitted completed installation
steps.instruction: Use a complete Windows installation and components you are independently permitted to use. Upstream’s full initial v1.0 route needs FinestHourRemasteredSetup.exe, FinestHourRemastered.index and every FinestHourRemastered.data.NNN part together; the latest update tag contains an updater, not a clean initial installer. This guide does not authorize fresh acquisition of the required original-derived remaster pack: its specific permission/authorized-source condition remains unresolved. An existing permitted copy can be retained independently; no hidden pack bypass is offered.

steps.title: Keep the exact supported original and preparation with upstream
steps.instruction: The supported original is your own PAL Europe Xbox Call of Duty: Finest Hour, title 4156002A version 3, with default.xbe SHA-1 938a7b1e17928de49cb3c5834d61abcd3d9081c8 and its complete game files. Upstream accepts a supported extracted folder (default.xbe, COD.PAK, AUDIO, SHELL and companions) or supported full-disc/XISO image. Keep originals unchanged; other regions, revisions or console versions are outside this guide. Complete upstream installation and first-start GPU shader preparation outside Portcove. The source-build route also requires the release’s remaster pack, shader recipes and settings; a compiled EXE alone is not a complete player.

steps.title: Select the ordinary initial native entry
steps.instruction: Select the completed installation’s CODFH.exe, use its complete creating installation directory as working directory, and leave arguments empty. Keep the matching assets, shader recipes/default settings and other installed companions. Do not select Setup.exe, Update.exe, release-unpack scripts, generated intermediates or another title. Saving launch details and Play are separate actions. This entry covers the selected initial native process; no full-campaign or all-transition session claim is made.

steps.title: Keep successor and updater operations outside this entry
steps.instruction: The SDK has a conditional quick-reboot path that starts a successor and exits the original process after readiness or a short wait. Retained evidence does not establish that a normal Finest Hour transition requires it; actual title use is Unknown. Portcove does not follow, adopt or terminate that successor, an updater’s relaunched game, or a settings-restart successor. Those operations and continuation through them are not offered by this entry. Close every actual game/successor and updater yourself before another attachment, relinking, backup, replacement or removal; a stopped original PID does not prove successors closed.

steps.title: Preserve every active data and recovery location
steps.instruction: Back up the complete installation and each active profile before upstream startup or maintenance. Settings live in codfh.toml beside the EXE, saves in hdd/, prepared shaders in shadercache/, and logs beside the game. Preserve any existing crash dumps and the original inputs separately. If an established external setup uses --instance N, preserve its hddN and instance logs separately rather than merging them with the default hdd. Do not keep recovery files in %TEMP%/FinestHourRemastered: upstream startup attempts cleanup of that updater scratch directory and retries locked leftovers. No migration, backup or save compatibility promise is supplied by this registration.

steps.title: Leave replacement and recovery with upstream
steps.instruction: Upstream installer/player owns preparation, first-start shader writes and runtime replacement. Its optional in-game Update action checks updater size/SHA-256, closes the game and starts an external updater that can relaunch it; do that outside this entry’s tracked-session scope and review the resulting completed installation before relinking changed bytes. Preserve independent backups and original files before updating or uninstalling. Removing Portcove registration preserves external files; Portcove does not own updates, rollback, data deletion, successor continuation or external-file recovery.

warnings: Source inspection and release metadata only: no installer, multipart payload, compiled output, native game, real save, installed-client or protected qualification was performed. Expected provider hashes are not newly observed package integrity or source/binary certification. Windows requirements include SSE4.2/x86-64-v2 and upstream-documented GPU requirements; no host hardware acceptance is claimed. Applicable code/component terms do not grant original-game/remaster-pack rights; the named fresh-acquisition condition remains separate.

listing.download_block_reason: Fresh Core acquisition of the selected Finest Hour Windows installer/required remaster-pack asset set is held: upstream identifies original COD.PAK textures and remastered game models in that pack, but an applicable grant for those selected components has not been established by the code/tool licenses. Resume with attributable permission/authorized source for the selected asset set or a separately reviewed supported preparation route excluding the unresolved components. An independently permitted completed copy remains distinct; successor-process continuation is not offered by its conditional ordinary-entry guide.
